blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.
blocks.zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)可以在不同环境之间执行范围广泛的任务,但其在代理环境下的表现仍然不为人所知。 虽然模拟器和现实世界环境中的在线评价对衡量互动代理业绩至关重要,但它们成本高昂,而且难以扩大规模。 补充性离线VQA基准可以使代理领域之间的比较更快和更可靠,但现有基准仍然有限和零散。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了AgentVQA,这是一个线下基准,用于评估网络代理、机器人、爱高中心视频、游戏和空间规划等五个代理领域的VLM。 我们通过手动从23个源数据集中选择1000个具有挑战性的现实世界代理实例,并将其用于可靠的离线评价来构建AgentVQA. 由此产生的基准保留了不同领域互动环境的现实情景,其模式排名跟踪相应在线评价的情景。 在22个评估模型中,最佳的准确度仅为58.5%。 我们的跨域分析显示,错误的驱动力主要在于未能对当前和不断发展的视觉状态进行地面和保持准确的表达,包括将相关的UI元素本地化,解释运动,跟踪状态随时间变化,推断3D空间关系,而不是任务误解或下游逻辑推理.

blocks.en: Section 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 第1节 导言

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are quickly becoming the decision-making core for agentic systems spanning robotics, web navigation, or gameplay. By prompting or fine-tuning, VLMs often outperform their domain-specific counterparts ( Koh et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Sarch et al., 2025 ) and serve as the backbone for top-performing action models ( Black et al., 2026 ; Black et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)正迅速成为代理系统跨越机器人,网络导航,或游戏游戏的决策核心. 通过催化或微调,VLM常超越其特定域的对应方(Koh等人,2024年;Black等人,2024年;Zhou等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年;Sarch等人,2025年),成为顶级行动模型的骨干(Black等人,2026年;Black等人,2025年;Ji等人,2025年).

blocks.en: In domains like mathematics and coding, standardized benchmarks have accelerated progress by systematically tracking model capabilities and reliably exposing performance gaps ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Balunović et al., 2025 ) . For agents, online evaluations in real or simulated environments remain the gold standard for assessing agentic performance ( Yao et al., 2024 ) , but due to computational cost and reproducibility, they present practical challenges for rapid, large-scale model comparison ( Henderson et al., 2018 ; Dasari et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 在数学和编码等领域,标准化基准通过系统地跟踪模型能力和可靠地揭露性能差距,加快了进展(Jimenez等人,2023年;Balunović等人,2025年)。 对于代理商,真实或模拟环境中的在线评价仍然是评估代理商性能的金本位(姚等人,2024年),但由于计算成本和可复制性,它们为快速,大规模模型比较带来了实际挑战(亨德森等人,2018年;达萨里等人,2022年).

blocks.en: As a result, VLMs’ agentic capabilities lack comparable evaluation frameworks. State-of-the-art models are often assessed on general-purpose benchmarks like MMMU ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and GPQA ( Rein et al., 2024 ) . While these benchmarks assess broad vision-language and language understanding, their questions and visual inputs do not reflect agentic decision-making scenarios. They primarily assess general visual understanding or knowledge-intensive reasoning. Recent works ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Yehudai et al., 2025 ; Wong et al., 2025 ) show that performance on general-purpose VQA benchmarks does not reliably correlate with success in agentic tasks.
blocks.zh: 因此,VLM的代理能力缺乏可比较的评价框架。 最新模型往往按照MMMU(Yue等人,2025年),MMBench(Liu等人,2024年)和GPQA(Rein等人,2024年)等通用基准进行评估。 虽然这些基准评估了广义的视觉语言和语言理解,但其问题和视觉投入并不反映代理决策情景。 它们主要评估一般视觉理解或知识密集型推理. 近期的著作(姚等人,2024年;叶胡代等人,2025年;黄等人,2025年)表明,在通用VQA基准上的表现与代理任务的成功并不可靠.

blocks.en: To address this, several domain-specific benchmarks have advanced evaluation of agentic capabilities within their respective settings ( Koh et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2024 ; Bonatti et al., 2025 ; Jang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) . However, these often provide narrow domain coverage, inputs and action spaces that do not reflect real agentic scenarios, or evaluation sets that are either saturated or affected by noisy annotations.
blocks.zh: 为解决这一问题,若干具体领域基准已对各自背景下的代理能力进行了高级评价(Koh等人,2024年;Rawles等人,2024年;Bonatti等人,2025年;Jang等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年b) 。 然而,它们往往提供狭义的域范围、投入和行动空间,不能反映真实的代理情景,或评价集要么饱和,要么受到噪音说明的影响。

blocks.en: We introduce AgentVQA , a manually curated benchmark for systematically evaluating general-purpose VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios. AgentVQA contains 1,000 single-image, multi-frame, and video-based multiple-choice questions curated from 23 datasets across five domains: Web Agents , Egocentric Videos , Robotics , Games , and Spatial Planning . These domains represent distinct forms of agent–environment interaction, including GUI navigation, temporally extended first-person understanding, embodied perception and action, strategic decision-making, and 3D spatial planning, as illustrated in Figure 1 . By evaluating these settings within a common benchmark, AgentVQA supports both aggregate model comparison and analysis of whether agentic capabilities generalize across domains.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AgentVQA,这是系统评估通用VLM在现实的Agentic假想情况下的人工化基准. AgentVQA包含1000个单像,多帧,和视频的多选择问题,由23个数据集解析,涉及五个领域:Web Agents,Egocent Videos,Robotics,Games,以及空间规划. 如图1所示,这些领域代表着不同形式的代理环境互动,包括GUI导航、时间延伸的第一人称理解、体现的认知和行动、战略决策和三维空间规划。 AgentVQA通过在共同基准内评估这些设置,支持汇总模型比较和分析代理能力是否在各领域通用.

blocks.en: We construct AgentVQA through a human-centered, model-assisted pipeline designed to provide broad coverage, standardized evaluation, and meaningful difficulty. VLMs screen candidates and propose hard distractors, while annotators select, repair, and verify every retained example. Only about 22% of the initial candidates survive the full curation pipeline, as human review identifies subtle ambiguities and annotation errors missed by automated checks and removes examples that are insufficiently challenging. The final benchmark expresses heterogeneous targets, including coordinates, actions, spatial relations, and predicted states, through a common multiple choice interface while preserving the semantics of the original tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个以人为中心、模型辅助的管道来构建AgentVQA,该管道旨在提供广泛的覆盖面、标准化的评价和有意义的困难。 VLMs筛选候选人,提出硬分心器,而注释者则选择,修复,并验证每个保留的例子. 只有大约22%的初始候选人在全面审阅过程中幸存下来,因为人文审查发现,自动化检查遗漏了微妙的含糊不清和注释错误,并删除了不够具有挑战性的例子。 最终基准通过一个共同的多选择界面来表达不同的目标,包括坐标,动作,空间关系和预测状态,同时保留原始任务的语义.

blocks.en: Model rankings on AgentVQA correlate with those from SpatialWorld ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , an online evaluation of agentic capabilities in simulation, supporting its use as a scalable complement to interactive evaluation. At the same time, its rankings differ substantially from those on broad visual and reasoning benchmarks such as MMMU-Pro, GPQA-Diamond, and ChartQAPro, suggesting that performance on conventional benchmarks does not reliably predict agentic competence. Across the 22 open- and closed-source models we evaluate, the strongest model achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Moreover, the strongest model differs across domains, showing that aggregate performance can obscure substantial variation in domain-specific capabilities.
blocks.zh: AgentVQA上的模型排名与SpaceWorld(Gao等人,2026年)的排名相关,后者是对模拟的代理能力的在线评价,支持将其用作互动评价的可扩展补充. 同时,其排名与MMMU-Pro,GPQA-Diamond,ChartQAPro等广义视觉和推理基准的排名大不相同,这表明在常规基准上的绩效并不能可靠地预测代理能力. 通过我们评价的22个开源和闭源模型,最强的模型只实现了58.5%的精度. 此外,不同领域最强的模型也各不相同,表明总体性能可以掩盖特定领域能力的巨大差异。

blocks.en: Our cross-domain error analysis reveals a shared limitation that manifests differently across agentic settings. Failures are dominated by grounded scene and state understanding: models struggle with UI localization in Web Agents , motion interpretation in Egocentric Videos , 3D spatial reasoning in Robotics and Spatial Planning , and visual state comprehension in Games . In contrast, failures arising from misunderstanding the task or selecting an answer inconsistent with the model’s reasoning are rare. These results suggest that current VLMs often understand the requested objective and can reliably reason over perceived inputs but fail to construct and maintain the grounded representation of the environment needed to act correctly.
blocks.zh: 我们的跨域错误分析揭示了一种共同的限制,这种限制在代理设置中表现不同。 失败主要表现为被禁足的场景和状态理解:模型在网络代理中与UI本地化(UI location in Web Agents)发生斗争,在爱歌中心视频中进行运动解释,在机器人和空间规划中进行3D空间推理,在Games中进行视觉状态理解. 与此相反,由于误解任务或选择与模型推理不一致的答案而造成的失败是罕见的. 这些结果表明,目前的自愿参与活动往往能理解所要求达到的目标,并且能够可靠地解释所认为的投入,但未能构建和保持正确行动所需环境的基础代表性。

blocks.en: Section 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 第2节 有关工作

blocks.en: VLM as agents. Recent advances in multimodal AI have been driven by the development of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). These models, such as QwenVL ( Bai et al., 2023 ) , GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) , and Gemini ( Deepmind, 2026 ) , are typically pretrained on vast, web-scale datasets of paired images and text. This equips them with a broad general-purpose understanding of both visual concepts and natural language, making them an ideal compute unit for agents. Several works have successfully adapted VLMs into specific domains, either by fine-tuning or scaffolding pre-trained models ( Black et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Sarch et al., 2025 ) . AgentVQA evaluates agentic capabilities across domains.
blocks.zh: VLM作为特工. 近年在多式联运方面取得的进步是由《远景-语言模式》的发展推动的。 这些模型,如QuenVL(Bai等人,2023年),GPT-4o(Hurst等人,2024年),和双子座(Deepmind,2026年)等,通常在庞大,网络尺度的成对图像和文本数据集上进行预训. 这使他们对视觉概念和自然语言都有广义的通用理解,使他们成为代理人的理想计算单位. 有几部作品通过微调或脚手架将VLM成功调整为具体领域(Black等人,2024年;Koh等人,2024年;Zhou等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年;Sarch等人,2025年)。 AgentVQA评价跨域的代理能力.

blocks.en: General visual question answering. A wealth of benchmarks have been developed to assess the general capabilities of VLMs, including SEED-Bench ( Li et al., 2023a ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , or MMMU ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . While invaluable for measuring core competencies and reasoning, they are ill-suited as proxies for agentic intelligence. Agentic tasks often require episodic memory ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ) because either the modalities are iterative, e.g., a stream of image observations, or the task requires interactive reasoning, e.g., tool-calling. Yao et al. (2024) found that GPT-4o, despite excelling on traditional benchmarks, achieves a success rate less than 50% on realistic customer service tasks requiring multi-turn interactions. In Fig. 6 , we confirm this observation by the divergence between rankings in AgentVQA vs MMMU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond.
blocks.zh: 一般性视觉问题回答. 已经制定了大量基准来评估脆弱LMs的一般能力,包括SEED-Bench(Li等人,2023年a),MMBench(Liu等人,2024年),或MMMU(Yue等人,2025年)。 虽然它们对于衡量核心能力和推理十分宝贵,但它们不适合作为代理情报。 代理任务往往需要偶联记忆(Majumdar等人,2024年),因为模式要么是迭代的,如图像观测流,要么任务需要交互推理,如工具调用. Yao等人(2024年)发现,GPT-4o尽管在传统基准上表现优异,但在需要多回合互动的现实客户服务任务上成功率低于50%. 在图6中,我们通过AgentVQA vs MMU-Pro 和 GPQA-Diamond 的排名差异来证实这一看法。

blocks.en: Agentic benchmarks. The agentic evaluation landscape spans language-only benchmarks, e.g., SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) and AgentBench ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , which test capabilities such as code generation and tool use, and vision-language benchmarks requiring visual grounding and spatial reasoning. These benchmarks can also be categorized as online or offline. Online benchmarks, e.g., ( Savva et al., 2019 ; Fan et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Koh et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , evaluate agents through environment interaction and therefore capture non-deterministic dynamics important for real-world deployment, but are often costly and infrastructure-intensive ( Henderson et al., 2018 ; Du et al., 2024 ) . Offline benchmarks, e.g., ( Rawles et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Team et al., 2025 ; Tong et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2025 ) , instead use verifiable question-answer tasks paired with visual inputs. However, existing offline benchmarks are largely domain-specific and differ in answer formats, option difficulty, and sample distributions, making direct aggregation and cross-domain analysis difficult (Table 4 ). AgentVQA is curated by filtering and transforming samples into a standardized, unambiguous multiple choice format with hard negatives.
blocks.zh: 代理基准。 代理评价景观跨越只使用语言的基准,例如SWE-bench(Jimenez等人,2023年)和Agent Bench(Liu等人,2023年),它们测试代码生成和工具使用等能力,以及需要视觉地面和空间推理的视觉语言基准. 这些基准也可归类为在线或离线。 在线基准,如(Savva等人,2019年;Fan等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年b;Koh等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年),通过环境互动评价剂,从而捕捉对现实世界部署至关重要的非决定性动态,但往往成本高昂和基础设施密集型(Henderson等人,2018年;Du等人,2024年)。 离线基准,例如(Rawles等人,2023年;Yang等人,2025年a;Team等人,2025年;Tong等人,2025年;Gong等人,2025年),而是使用可核查的问答任务与视觉输入对齐. 然而,现有的离线基准基本上是针对具体域的,在答案格式、选项难度和样本分布方面各不相同,因此难以进行直接汇总和跨域分析(表4)。 AgentVQA通过过滤和将样品转化成具有硬底片的标准化,毫不含糊的多种选择格式来进行校验.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Dataset curation pipeline for AgentVQA. (1) Collect candidates across 23 datasets, task types, and input modalities spanning five agentic domains. (2) Standardize tasks as MCQs; Gemini 2.5 Pro proposes three hard negatives when needed. (3) Gemini and Claude flag ambiguity, annotation errors, and weak distractors, removing approximately 45% of candidates. (4) Human annotators review, edit, and repair the remaining samples, rejecting approximately 60% as ambiguous, incorrect, or too easy. (5) Verify exactly one correct answer and plausible, unambiguously incorrect hard negatives, then assemble 1,000 manually verified questions balanced across the five domains.
blocks.zh: 图3:用于AgentVQA的数据集目录。 (1) 收集涉及五个代理领域的23个数据集、任务类型和输入模式的候选人。 (2)将任务标准化为MCQ;双子座2.5 Pro在需要时提出3个硬负数. (3)双子座和克劳德旗模糊,注释错误,以及弱的分散注意力者,将大约45%的候选人删除. (4) 人类注释员审查、编辑和修复剩余的样本,拒绝约60%的样本为含糊、不正确或过于容易。 (5) 核实一个准确的正确答案和可信、明确无误的硬负数,然后汇编1 000个在五个领域平衡的人工核实的问题。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Ambiguities addressed by manual curation (Stage 4, Section 3.1 ). (a) A rectangular bounding box around scissors includes background, allowing clicks that miss the object to be scored as correct. blocks.en: Section 3 The AgentVQA Benchmark
blocks.zh: 第3节 代理人VQA 基准

blocks.en: We define agentic tasks as those that evaluate action selection or the perceptual and reasoning capabilities required for goal-directed interaction with an environment Bengio et al. (2025) . To support scalable offline evaluation of these capabilities, AgentVQA comprises 1,000 manually curated multiple-choice questions drawn from 23 datasets spanning five agentic domains. Its construction is guided by three principles: comprehensive coverage across domains to assess skill generality; standardized evaluation using manually curated questions with unambiguous ground truth; and challenging examples, states, and negative options designed to expose fine-grained weaknesses in current models.
blocks.zh: 我们把代理任务定义为评价行动选择或目标导向与环境的互动所需的感知和推理能力的任务(2025年)。 为支持对这些能力进行可扩展的离线评价,AgentVQA由1 000个人工解析的多选择问题组成,这些问题来自23个数据集,涉及五个代理领域。 它的构建遵循三项原则:全面涵盖各领域,以评估技能的通用性;使用手动解答的问题进行标准化评价,明确地面真相;以及挑战性的例子、状态和旨在暴露现有模式中微弱弱点的负面选择。

blocks.en: To provide comprehensive coverage, AgentVQA spans five distinct forms of agent-environment interaction: digital interaction and GUI navigation in Web Agents ; embodied perception and action in Robotics ; temporally extended first-person planning in Egocentric Videos ; strategic decision-making in Games ; and spatial navigation and planning in Spatial Planning . The benchmark is balanced across domains, with 200 questions per domain (Figure 2 ). Its inputs range from individual screenshots and embodied-scene images to multi-frame trajectories, egocentric videos, and gameplay videos. Heterogeneous targets, including coordinates, actions, spatial relations, and predicted states, are represented through a common multiple-choice format while preserving observations of the agentic scenario. See Appendix B for full details of the datasets.
blocks.zh: 为了提供全面报道,AgentVQA跨越了五种不同的代理与环境互动形式:网络代理中的数字互动和GUI导航;机器人中体现的认知和行动;Egocentritics视频中的时间延伸第一人称规划;游戏中的战略决策;空间规划中的空间导航和规划。 该基准在各域之间平衡,每个域有200个问题(图2 ). 其投入范围从个人截图和隐形场景图像到多帧轨迹,以自我为中心的视频,以及游戏播放视频. 异质目标,包括坐标,动作,空间关系,以及预测状态,通过共同的多选择格式来表示,同时保留对代理情景的观测. 见附录 B是数据集的全部细节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Curation and Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据校准和构建

blocks.en: We construct AgentVQA through a five-stage, human-centered pipeline. VLMs assist with large-scale screening and hard-negative generation, while human annotators determine which examples are retained and verify the correctness, clarity, and difficulty of every final question.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个以人为中心的五级管道建造了AgentVQA. VLM协助进行大规模筛选和硬阴性生成,而人类注释者则决定保留哪些实例,并验证每个最终问题的正确性,清晰度和难度.

blocks.en: Stage 1: Candidate collection. We assemble a diverse candidate pool from 23 source datasets spanning five agentic domains (see Appendix B for full dataset list). Candidates are sampled across datasets, task types, and input modalities to cover a broad range of realistic observations, states, and decisions, while initially retaining their original questions, annotations, and answer formats.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:候选人收集。 我们从23个源数据集中汇集了来自5个代理域的不同候选集合(完整的数据集清单见附录B)。 候选人在数据集、任务类型和输入模式之间进行抽样,以涵盖广泛的现实观察、状态和决定,同时最初保留其最初的问题、说明和回答格式。

blocks.en: Stage 2: MCQ construction. We convert the candidate tasks into a common multiple-choice format. For examples that are not originally multiple choice, Gemini 2.5 Pro proposes three hard negative options using the visual input, task prompt, correct answer, action history, and relevant task metadata. The generated distractors include both near-miss negatives, which differ from the correct answer in a fine-grained way, and semantically similar negatives, which correspond to plausible but incorrect objects, actions, or locations.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段:MCQ建设. 我们把候选任务转变为共同的多选择格式。 对于原本不是多重选择的例子,双子座2.5 Pro提出了三个使用视觉输入,任务即时,正确答案,动作历史,以及相关任务元数据的硬负选项. 生成的分流器既包括接近误差的负数(以精细的方式与正确答案不同),也包括类似反数(与可信但错误的物体、行动或位置相对应)。

blocks.en: Stage 3: VLM-assisted screening. We use a multi-turn verification pipeline with Gemini and Claude to identify converted questions with ambiguous instructions, inconsistent annotations, multiple plausible answers, malformed states, implausible distractors, or other quality issues. This high-recall screening removes approximately 45% of the initial candidate pool, reducing the amount of manual review required while preserving human judgment for cases involving subtle visual or domain-specific ambiguities.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:由VLM协助进行筛选。 我们用双子座和克劳德的多回合核查管道 来找出被转换的问题 带有模棱两可的指令 不一致的说明 多重合理的答案 状态不合理 难以想象的分散注意力者或其他质量问题 这种高召回的筛选取消了大约45%的最初候选人名单,减少了需要人工审查的数量,同时保留了人们对涉及微妙视觉或特定领域模糊不清的案件的判断。

blocks.en: Stage 4: Manual curation and repair. Human annotators then inspect the remaining candidates for correctness, difficulty, diversity, and relevance to agentic decision-making. Approximately 60% of the samples that pass automated screening are still rejected because they contain subtle ambiguities, annotation errors, invalid distractors, or are insufficiently challenging. When possible, annotators repair promising examples by refining the question, ground-truth answer, visual input, answer choices, or associated metadata before retaining them for the final evaluation format.
blocks.zh: 第4阶段:人工整理和修理。 然后,人类注释员检查其余候选人的正确性、难度、多样性以及与代理决策的相关性。 大约60%的通过自动筛选的样本仍然被拒绝,因为这些样本含有微妙的模糊性、注释错误、无效的分散干扰器或不够具有挑战性。 在可能的情况下,注释者通过完善问题、地面真相答案、视觉输入、答案选择或相关元数据来修复有希望的例子,然后将其保留用于最后评价格式。

blocks.en: Stage 5: Human verification and benchmark assembly. Every completed MCQ is manually reviewed a second time to ensure that exactly one answer is correct and that the distractors are plausible, challenging, and unambiguously incorrect. This step along with Manual Curation is especially important for grounding tasks, where bounding boxes and automatic spatial checks can admit false positives or reject valid interaction points, as illustrated in Figure 4 . We revise questions, annotations, and options as needed, then assemble a balanced final benchmark of 1,000 manually verified questions, with 200 examples per domain and 40 or 50 examples from each source dataset.
blocks.zh: 第5阶段:人类核查和基准组装。 每一个完成的MCQ都得到第二次人工审查,以确保准确的答案是正确的,分散注意力者是可信的、具有挑战性的和毫不含糊的不正确的。 如图4所示,这一步骤与《手动校验》一起对地面作业特别重要,因为边框和自动空间检查可以承认虚假的正值或拒绝有效的相互作用点。 我们根据需要修改问题、说明和选项,然后汇编一个平衡的最终基准,即1 000个人工核实的问题,每个域有200个实例,每个源数据集有40或50个实例。

blocks.en: Section 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 第4节 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we investigate the ability of different models to perform agentic visual tasks across the diverse inputs curated in AgentVQA. We first describe the evaluation setup and model suite in Section 4.1 . We then report overall model performance across domains, domain-level trends, action-history effects, open- versus closed-source models, and reasoning variants in Section 4.2 , compare AgentVQA rankings with existing offline benchmarks in Section 4.3 , and assess its reliability as a lower-cost alternative to online agent evaluation through a comparison with SpatialWorld in Section 4.4 . Finally, we examine the failure modes in Section 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们调查了不同模型在AgentVQA所编译的各种输入中执行代理视觉任务的能力. 我们首先描述第4.1节的评价设置和模式套装。 然后,我们在第4.2节中报告跨域的总体模型绩效、域级趋势、行动历史效应、开放与封闭源模型以及推理变体,比较AgentVQA排名与第4.3节的现有离线基准,并通过与第4.4节SpaceWorld进行比较,评估其可靠性,将其作为网上代理评价的低成本替代办法。 最后,我们将审查4.5节中的失败模式。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate a diverse suite of 22 prominent VLMs to ensure a comprehensive assessment of the current landscape. Our selection includes closed-source models: GPT-5.6-sol thinking-high/none ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , GPT-5.6-luna thinking-high/none ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google, 2026 ) and 3.7 Flash ( Deepmind, 2026 ) , Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) and Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , and Qwen3.7 Plus and Flash ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . We also include a wide range of open-source models: the GLM series (4.6V ( Z.AI, 2025 ) , 4.5V ( GLM-V Team, 2026 ) , 4.1V-9B-Thinking/Base ( GLM-V Team, 2026 ) ), Kimi K3 ( Team, 2026 ) , Llama 4 Maverick ( Meta, 2025 ) , the Qwen3.5 series (397B-A17B, 122B-A10B, 35B-A3B, 27B) ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , and Qwen3.8 27B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) .
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评估一套由22个突出的自愿活动内容组成的多样化套件,以确保对目前的情况进行全面评估。 我们的选择包括闭源模型:GPT-5.6-sol思维高/无(OpenAI,2026年),GPT-5.6-luna思维高/无(OpenAI,2026年),GPT-4o(Hurst等人,2024年),双子座3.1 Pro(Google,2026年)和3.7 Flash(Deepmind,2026年),Claude Opus 4.8(Anthropic,2026a)和Sonnet 5(Anthropic,2026b),以及Quen3.7 Plus和Flash(Quen Team,2026b). 我们还包括多种开源模型:GLM系列(4.6V(Z.AI,2025年),4.5V(GLM-V Team,2026年),4.1V-9B-Thinking/Base(GLM-V Team,2026年)),Kimi K3(Team,2026年),Llama 4 Maverick(Meta,2025年),Quen3.5系列(397B-A17B,122B-A10B,35B-A3B,27B). (Quen Team, 2026a ),以及 Quen3.8 27B (Quen Team, 2026c ).

blocks.en: Models are categorized as “Reasoning” or “Non-Reasoning” based on whether they allocate extended token budgets for internal chain-of-thought reasoning before producing a final answer.
blocks.zh: 模型被归类为“反响”或“非反响”,其依据是它们是否在提出最后答案之前为内部思维链式推理分配扩大的代号预算。

blocks.en: Evaluation setup. For models that do not natively support video input, we sample 32 frames at evenly spaced intervals. This number is validated by our own ablation studies and prior work ( Yang et al., 2025a ) . Models are evaluated with a temperature of 0.8 and 0.2 for reasoning and non-reasoning models, respectively. For models without manual temperature like GPT series, we use the default.
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 对于不本土支持视频输入的模型,我们以均匀间隔抽取32帧. 这一数字通过我们自己的衰竭研究和以前的工作加以验证(杨等人,2025a.)。 模型的评价温度分别为0.8和0.2,用于推理模型和非推理模型. 对于没有手动温度的模型,如GPT系列,我们使用默认.

blocks.en: We use a standard prompt that provides the question and any relevant context, querying the model to output only the single letter corresponding to its choice. For questions involving spatial coordinates, options are formatted in each model’s native convention (e.g., normalized [0, 1000] in (y, x) order for Gemini, absolute pixel coordinates for Qwen). Final answers are extracted programmatically, and all visual inputs are provided at native resolution. Further details on prompts and answer extraction are in Appendices K and E .
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个标准提示,提供问题和任何相关的上下文,查询模型只输出与其选择相对应的单个字母. 对于涉及空间坐标的问题,可选用每个模型的原生公约格式(例如,将双子座的[0,1000]按(y,x)顺序排列,Quen的绝对像素坐标)。 最终答案按程序提取,所有视觉输入均以本地分辨率提供。 关于提示和答案提取的进一步详情载于附录K和E。

blocks.zh: 表1:在五个代理领域对代理VQA的VLM的性能. 代表理性模型。 代表闭源模型。 粗体和下划线数字分别表明每列军衔最佳和次等。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on AgentVQA
blocks.zh: 4.2 关于代理人VQA的结果

blocks.en: We report the results on AgentVQA in Table 1 . We draw the following conclusions:
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中报告AgentVQA的结果. 我们得出以下结论:

blocks.en: Top models struggle with AgentVQA. Even the top performing model, Gemini 3.7 Flash, achieves only 58.5% accuracy. A clear tiering is observable: the largest proprietary models (GPT-5.6, Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro) are at the top, followed by other competitive models such as Qwen3.7 Flash and the open-weight Qwen3.8 27B, with smaller and older-generation models in the lower tiers. Among the five domains, models perform best on Egocentric Videos and Games , followed by Spatial Planning , Robotics , and worst on Web Agents . This indicates that current VLMs are stronger at temporally contextualized visual understanding and game-state reasoning than at precise GUI grounding and spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 顶级模特和AgentVQA吵架. 甚至顶级的性能模型双子座3.7 Flash也只实现了58.5%的精度. 清晰的分层可观测到:最大的专有型号(GPT-5.6,双子座3.7 Flash,双子座3.1 Pro)位于顶部,其次是其他竞争型号,如Qune3.7 Flash和开放重量的Qune3.8 27B,下层有较小和较老的一代型号. 在五大领域中, 这表明,与精确的GUI定位和空间推理相比,当前VLM在时间背景化的视觉理解和游戏状态推理上更强.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Impact of action history on model performance in Web Agents .
blocks.zh: 图5:行动历史对网络代理公司模型性能的影响

blocks.en: Large variance per domain. Current VLMs are strongest on temporally grounded understanding ( Egocentric Videos : 59%, Games : 51.5%) and weaker on precise grounding and embodied reasoning ( Spatial Planning : 46%, Robotics : 38%, Web Agents : 29%). Web Agents is the hardest domain, with only three models exceeding 40%. Games exhibits the largest spread (23% to 70%), suggesting strategic reasoning is strong only in the most capable models. No single model dominates across all domains: Gemini 3.7 Flash leads Games (70%) but falls behind GPT-5.6-sol thinking-high in Web Agents (40.5% vs. 47%), while Qwen3.7 Flash leads Egocentric Videos (72.5%) and Gemini 3.7 Flash leads Spatial Planning (62.5%) and Robotics (52.5%). These cross-domain rank shifts indicate highly uneven capabilities across different settings.
blocks.zh: 每个域差异很大。 目前VLM在基于时间的理解上最强(爱高中心视频:59%,Games:51.5%),在精确定位和体现推理上更弱(空间规划:46%,机器人:38%,网络代理:29%). Web Agents是最难的域名,只有三种型号超过40%. 游戏展出量最大(23%至70%),说明战略推理只有在最有能力的模型中才有力. 没有单一模式在所有领域占主导地位:双子座3.7 Flash领先Games(70%),但在Web Agents(40.5%对47%)中却落后于GPT-5.6-sol思维高,而Quen3.7 Flash领先Egocent Videos(72.5%),双子座3.7 Flash领先空间规划(62.5%)和机器人(52.5%). 这些跨域的分级变化表明不同场合的能力高度不平衡.

blocks.en: The gap between closed-source and open-source models remains narrow. The top closed-source model, Gemini 3.7 Flash (58.5%), leads the top open-source model, Qwen3.8 27B (50.9%), by 7.6%. Kimi K3 (48.3%), Qwen3.5 35B (47.9%), and Qwen3.5 397B (47.8%) outperform Claude Opus 4.8 (44.0%) and Sonnet 5 (43.4%). Multiple open-source models also substantially outperform GPT-5.6-sol thinking-none (38.2%) and GPT-4o (31.4%). These results suggest that while the strongest proprietary models retain an advantage on agentic tasks, competitive open-source alternatives already match many closed-source systems.
blocks.zh: 闭源模型和开源模型之间的差距仍然很小. 顶端闭源模型双子座3.7 Flash(58.5%)领先顶端开源模型Quen3.8 27B(50.9%),比7.6%. Kimi K3(48.3%)、Quen3.5 35B(47.9%)和Quen3.5 397B(47.8%)的成绩超过Claude Opus 4.8(44.0%)和Sonnet 5(43.4%)。 多种开源模型也大大超过GPT-5.6-sol思维-none(38.2%)和GPT-4o(31.4%)。 这些结果表明,虽然最强的专有模式在代理任务上保持优势,但竞争性开源替代品已经与许多闭源系统相匹配.

blocks.en: Extended reasoning helps some models but not others. GPT-5.6-sol gains 16.8 points with thinking-high, while GLM 4.1V performs worse with thinking as compared to without it. We find that GLM-4.1V-Thinking gets stuck in “thinking loops” (App. J ).
blocks.zh: 扩展推理有助于一些模型,但不利于其他模型。 GPT-5.6-sol以16.8分的思维高得分,而GLM 4.1V的思维表现则比无思维表现差. 我们发现GLM-4.1V-Thinking被困在“思维循环”(App.J)中。

blocks.en: Our ablation on Web Agents tasks reveals that providing action history is a consistent benefit (Figure 5 ). Across five models (Gemini 3.1-pro, GPT-4o, Qwen3.5 27B, Kimi K3, and Claude Sonnet 5), removing the history decreases average performance by 9.5% on AitW and 10% on MONDAY. This confirms that access to historical context is critical for multi-step tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们关于网络代理的任务表明,提供行动历史是一个持续的好处(图5)。 横跨5种型号(Gemini 3.1-pro,GPT-4o,Quen3.5 27B,Kimi K3和Claude Sonnet 5),删除了AitW上的平均性能下降9.5%,Monday上的平均性能下降10%. 这证实,了解历史背景对于多步骤的任务至关重要。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Divergence in model performance rankings between AgentVQA and three existing benchmarks. Lines are colored red if a model’s rank degrades and purple if it improves. The rank divergence shows that our benchmark has moderate-to-weak correlation with general VQA benchmarks. While a few models maintain their ranks, the relative positions of most others change. In the comparison with GPQA-Diamond, no model maintains its relative ranking.
blocks.zh: 图6:AgentVQA与三个现有基准在模型性能排名上的差异. 如果一个模型的级别下降,如果改进,则线条为红色,紫色。 军衔差异表明,我们的基准与一般的VQA基准有中度对弱的关联。 虽然少数模式保持了自己的排名,但大多数其他模式的相对位置有所变化. 在与GPQA-Diamond的比较中,没有任何型号保持相对排名.

blocks.en: 4.3 Rank Correlation
blocks.zh: 4.3 军衔关联

blocks.en: To validate the benefit of a specialized agentic benchmark, we compare model rankings for a subset of models on AgentVQA to those on a subset of MMMU-Pro ( Yue et al., 2025 ) (250 samples), ChartQA-Pro ( Masry et al., 2025 ) (250 samples), and GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) (150 samples), running our own evaluations with standardized prompts. As shown in Figure 6 , rankings diverge substantially. Spearman’s rank correlation coefficients are moderate for MMMU-Pro ( ρ = 0.67 \rho=0.67 ) and GPQA-Diamond ( ρ = 0.59 \rho=0.59 ), and weak for ChartQA-Pro ( ρ = 0.44 \rho=0.44 ).
blocks.zh: 为了验证专门剂基准的好处,我们将AgentVQA上的一个子集模型的排名与MMMU-Pro(Yue等人,2025年)(250个样本)、ChartQA-Pro(Masry等人,2025年)(250个样本)和GPQA-Diamond(Rein等人,2024年)(150个样本)的子集模型的排名进行比较,以标准化的速率进行我们自己的评价。 如图6所示,排名相差很大。 斯皮尔曼的排名相关系数对MMMU-Pro(ρ = 0.67\rho= 0.67)和GPQA-Diamond(ρ = 0.59\rho= 0.59)来说是中度的,对ChartQA-Pro(ρ = 0.44\rho= 0.44)来说是弱的.

blocks.en: No single model dominates across all comparisons. Gemini 3.1 Pro ranks second on AgentVQA and MMMU-Pro but drops to 5th on GPQA-Diamond, while Qwen3.8 27B leads GPQA-Diamond but falls to 6th on MMMU-Pro. These shifts confirm that strong performance on general-purpose visual reasoning does not reliably predict agentic competence.
blocks.zh: 在所有比较中,没有一个单一模式占主导地位。 双子座3.1 Pro在AgentVQA和MMMU-Pro排名第二,但在GPQA-Diamond排名第5位,而Quen3.8 27B则领先GPQA-Diamond,但在MMU-Pro排名第6位. 这些转变证实,在通用视觉推理上的强性能并不能可靠地预测代理能力.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : AgentVQA ranks models the way an online interactive benchmark does. (a) Spearman correlation between each AgentVQA domain and the two SpatialWorld tracks over 12 shared models; saturated bars are the domain-matched pairs. (b) Model rankings under AgentVQA Spatial Planning against the SpatialWorld Physical track ( ρ = 0.895 \rho=0.895 , p = 8 × 10 − 5 p=8\times 10^{-5} ). Purple marks models that rank higher on SpatialWorld, red for models lower on it, and black unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图7:AgentVQA将模型排在在线互动基准的级别. (a) 每个AgentVQA域与两个空间世界轨道之间超过12个共享模型的斯皮尔曼关联;饱和条是域匹配的对子. (b) AgentVQA空间规划下对照空间世界物理轨迹的模型排名(ρ=0.895\rho=0.895,p=8×10−5p=8\times 10^{5}). 紫色标记模型在SpaceWorld上名列前茅,红色表示模型在它的下方,黑色不变.

blocks.en: 4.4 Correlation with Online Agent Evaluations
blocks.zh: 4.4 与在线代理评价的相关性

blocks.en: To examine whether AgentVQA provides a reliable alternative to costly interactive evaluation, we compare its model rankings with performance on SpatialWorld ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , a closed-loop benchmark for embodied and interactive agents. SpatialWorld scores are obtained from the official released evaluation results, which are produced under a single simulator-agnostic protocol across eight simulation backends. For this comparison, we separately evaluate 12 models from SpatialWorld on AgentVQA and compare their relative rankings via Spearman’s rank correlation. This analysis measures whether AgentVQA preserves the model ordering observed under interactive evaluation despite operating entirely offline and avoiding environment configuration and execution-related computational costs.
blocks.zh: 为了审查AgentVQA是否为昂贵的互动评价提供了可靠的替代方法,我们将其模型排名与SpaceWorld(Gao等人,2026年)上的性能进行比较,SpaceWorld是体现和互动的封闭-loop基准. 空间世界的得分来自官方发布的评价结果,这些评价结果是在8个模拟后端的单一模拟-不可知协议下产生的. 在SpaceWorld的AgentVQA上, 这种分析衡量AgentVQA是否保留了在互动评价中观察到的模型订单,尽管操作完全离线,并避免了环境配置和与执行有关的计算费用.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows a strong positive Spearman rank correlation of ρ = 0.895 \rho=\textbf{0.895} across 12 overlapping models between SpatialWorld and AgentVQA Spatial Planning, the closest category. This agreement demonstrates that AgentVQA provides a reliable and substantially lower-cost offline alternative for ranking agentic models, avoiding the environment setup, repeated rollouts, and computational expense required by online evaluation. The lower correlations for other AgentVQA domains suggest that model rankings depend on the capabilities being assessed, highlighting the limitations of a single dataset as a proxy for overall agentic performance. Together with the strong agreement in the matched domain, this pattern supports the interpretation that AgentVQA captures meaningful domain-specific performance differences.
blocks.zh: 图7显示,空间世界和AgentVQA空间规划(最接近的类别)之间的12个重叠模型之间,Spearman排位关系强烈,为 $ = 0.895\rho=\textbf{0.895}。 该协议表明,AgentVQA为代理模型的排名提供了可靠且成本低得多的离线替代方案,避免了在线评价所需的环境设置,重复推出和计算费用. 与其他AgentVQA域的较低关联性表明,模型排名取决于被评估的能力,凸显了单一数据集作为整体代理性能的代称的局限性. 这种模式与匹配域的强烈一致,支持AgentVQA捕捉有意义的域特定性能差异的解释.

blocks.en: 4.5 Error Modes
blocks.zh: 4.5 错误模式

blocks.en: To understand why models fail, we analyze incorrect predictions from Gemini 3.1 Pro, sampled evenly across datasets. We prompt the model to provide its reasoning with each answer, manually establish a taxonomy of common failure modes, and use Gemini to categorize the errors. We then manually review a randomly selected subset with 100 error mode assignments in total across the five domains.
blocks.zh: 为了理解模型为何失败,我们分析了双子座3.1 Pro的不正确的预测,对数据集进行了均匀的抽样. 我们促使模型提供每个答案的推理,手动建立常见故障模式的分类,并使用双子座来分类错误. 然后我们手动审查一个随机选择的子集,在五个领域总共分配了100个错误模式。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Distribution of the most common error modes across the five agentic domains in AgentVQA. The analysis is based on a semi-automated categorization of the incorrect predictions from Gemini-3.1-Pro. The chart is organized by domain, with each colored segment representing a primary domain. Each bar within a segment corresponds to a specific error mode, and its size reflects its prevalence (%).
blocks.zh: 图8:AgentVQA中五个代理域最常见的错误模式分布. 该分析基于双子座-3.1-Pro的不正确预测的半自动分类. 图表按域排列,每个色段代表主域. 一个段内的每个条都对应特定的误差模式,其大小反映了它的流行程度(%).

blocks.en: For Gemini 3.1 Pro, the results reveal domain-specific manifestations of a shared weakness: constructing an accurate task-relevant state from visual observations (Figure 8 ). Among the analyzed incorrect Web Agents predictions, 78% were classified as grounding errors, indicating difficulty locating the correct interface element. All percentages refer to the distribution of error categories among analyzed incorrect predictions within each domain. In Games , visual miscomprehension (71%) shows that failures primarily arise from reading the game state rather than applying its rules. Robotics and Spatial Planning are dominated by spatial confusion (65%) and viewpoint gaps (62%), respectively, exposing weaknesses in relational and perspective-aware reasoning. Errors in Egocentric Videos are more distributed across motion misperception (39%), perception gaps (29%), and spatial confusion (15%), reflecting difficulty tracking dynamic states. Across domains, failures therefore arise mainly before high-level planning, during perception, grounding, and state construction. Additional details are provided in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 双子座3.1 Pro,结果揭示了一个共同弱点的域特定表现:从视觉观测中构建一个准确的任务相关状态(图8 ). 在经过分析的不正确的Web Agents预测中,有78%被归类为落地错误,表明难以找到正确的界面元素. 所有百分比都指在每个领域分析的不正确预测中错误类别的分布情况。 在Games 中,视觉误解(71%)表明失败主要产生于阅读游戏状态,而不是应用其规则. 机器人学和空间规划分别以空间混淆(65%)和视差(62%)为主,暴露了关系推理和视差推理的弱点. Egocentral Video中的错误在运动误解(39%),感知差距(29%)和空间混乱(15%)中分布得更多,反映了跟踪动态状态的困难. 因此,在所有领域,失败主要发生在高层规划、感知、地面和州建设期间。 详情见附录G。

blocks.en: Section 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 第5节 结论

blocks.en: We introduce AgentVQA, a unified offline benchmark that consolidates 23 datasets across five agentic domains into 1,000 manually verified multiple-choice questions with challenging hard negatives. While prior work typically evaluates agents within individual environments or domains ( Koh et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2024 ; Bonatti et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , AgentVQA enables controlled comparison of visual decision-making capabilities across diverse agentic settings.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AgentVQA,一个统一的离线基准,将跨越五个代理域的23个数据集合并为1000个人工验证的多选择问题,并带有挑战性硬底. 虽然先前的工作通常对个别环境或领域内的物剂进行评价(Koh等人,2024年;Rawles等人,2024年;Bonatti等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年b),但AgentVQA能够对不同物剂环境的视觉决策能力进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en: Our results show that these capabilities remain far from solved: among 22 state-of-the-art VLMs, the strongest model achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our analysis of Gemini 3.1 Pro’s incorrect predictions identifies grounding, perception, motion understanding, and spatial state construction as the predominant error categories. Action history improves performance, while reasoning benefits some models but not others. However, neither closes the remaining gap. Moreover, AgentVQA rankings diverge from traditional VQA benchmarks while correlating strongly with SpatialWorld, suggesting that conventional benchmarks do not fully capture agentic readiness and that AgentVQA offers a reliable, substantially lower-cost alternative for rapid agent-model evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,这些能力远未解决:在22种最先进的VLM中,最强的模型只有58.5%的精度. 我们对双子座3.1 Pro错误预测的分析将地面、感知、运动理解和空间状态构造确定为主要错误类别。 动作史可以提高性能,而推理则有利于一些模型,但不利于其他模型. 然而,两者都无法弥合剩余差距。 此外,AgentVQA的排名偏离了传统的VQA基准,而与SpaceWorld关系密切,这表明传统基准不能充分反映AgentVQA的战备状态,AgentVQA为快速Agent-model评价提供了可靠且成本低得多的替代方案.

blocks.en: Taken together, these findings support viewing agentic competence as a collection of domain-specific capabilities rather than a single general ability. The strong agreement with online evaluation in the matched domain, alongside weaker cross-domain agreement, suggests that AgentVQA can help distinguish these capabilities and guide more targeted model development. Within the broader evaluation landscape, controlled offline benchmarks can complement interactive environments by identifying weaknesses efficiently and directing subsequent online testing toward the domains and failure modes that require closer investigation.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些结论支持将代理能力视为对特定领域能力的收集,而不是单一的一般能力。 与对应域的在线评价的强烈一致,以及较弱的跨域协议,表明AgentVQA可以帮助区分这些能力并指导更有针对性的模型开发. 在更广泛的评价范围内,可控离线基准可以通过有效查明弱点和引导随后的在线测试面向需要更密切调查的领域和故障模式来补充互动环境。

blocks.en: Future work should connect specific offline error patterns to failures during interactive execution. Such analyses could guide improvements in grounding and state tracking while testing whether gains on controlled questions translate into more reliable online behavior.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应该将具体的离线错误模式与交互式执行过程中的失败联系起来. 这种分析可以指导改进地面定位和状态跟踪工作,同时检验在受控问题上取得的成果是否转化为更可靠的在线行为。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Selection and Curation Rationale
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集选择和校正理由

blocks.en: The construction of AgentVQA is guided by a principled selection process to ensure the final benchmark is comprehensive, robust, and effective for evaluating the agentic capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Our domains: Web Agents , Egocentric Videos , Robotics , Games , and Spatial Planning are chosen to represent a broad spectrum of agentic challenges, from digital interaction to embodied physical perception and strategic planning. The following five criteria are central to our selection of the 23 source datasets.
blocks.zh: AgentVQA的构建遵循原则性选择程序,以确保最终基准全面,有力,有效评价Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)的代理能力. 我们的领域:网络代理、爱歌中心视频、机器人、游戏和空间 选择规划是为了代表广泛的代理挑战,从数字互动到体现物理感知和战略规划。 以下五个标准是我们选择23个源数据集的核心。

blocks.en: A primary requirement is that each dataset’s tasks must involve a strong “agentic signal.” This means moving beyond passive visual question answering (e.g., “What color is the car?”) to scenarios that demand active reasoning from an agent’s perspective. We prioritize datasets where the core task involves: • Choosing actions or predicting the next optimal step. • Evaluating the consequences of a sequence of actions. • Understanding causality and the relationships between actions and outcomes. • Strategic planning toward a specific goal. This focus ensures that AgentVQA directly probes the decision-making and reasoning capabilities that are fundamental to agentic intelligence.
blocks.zh: 一个首要要求是每个数据集的任务必须包含一个强大的“积极信号”。 这意味着超越被动视觉问题回答(例如 " 汽车是什么颜色? " ),转向从代理人的角度要求主动推理的情景. • 选择行动或预测下一个最佳步骤。 评估一系列行动的后果。 • 了解因果关系以及行动和结果之间的关系。 • 为特定目标进行战略规划。 这一重点确保了AgentVQA直接探究对代理智能至关重要的决策和推理能力.

blocks.en: Choosing actions or predicting the next optimal step.
blocks.zh: 选择动作或预测下一个最佳步骤.

blocks.en: Evaluating the consequences of a sequence of actions.
blocks.zh: 评估一系列行动的后果。

blocks.en: Understanding causality and the relationships between actions and outcomes.
blocks.zh: 理解因果关系和行动与结果之间的关系。

blocks.en: Strategic planning toward a specific goal.
blocks.zh: 为特定目标进行战略规划。

blocks.en: To test for generalist agentic behavior, we select datasets that span diverse domains and modalities. Each of the five chosen domains introduces a unique set of challenges and required skills not fully covered by the others: • Web Agents : Tests GUI navigation, grounding, and interaction in a digital environment. • Robotics & Egocentric Videos : Evaluate embodied perception, spatial awareness, and understanding of the physical world from a first-person perspective. • Games : Focus on strategic decision-making, reward modeling, and long-term planning in rule-based environments. • Spatial Planning : Assesses foundational spatial awareness and reasoning, a critical component for any embodied agent. This multi-domain approach prevents the benchmark from being too narrow and allows for a holistic assessment of a VLM’s generalization ability.
blocks.zh: 为了测试通用代理行为,我们选择了跨越不同领域和模式的数据集. 所选择的五个领域都引入了一组独特的挑战和其他领域没有充分涵盖的必要技能: 网络代理:测试GUI导航、定位和在数字环境中的互动。 • 机器人与爱高中心 视频 : 从第一人称角度评价对物理世界的固有认知、空间意识和理解。 • 支助 游戏:注重战略决策,奖励建模,规则环境下的长期规划. • 空间规划:评估基本空间意识和推理,这是任何体现的代理人的关键组成部分。 这种多领域方法可以防止基准过于狭窄,从而能够对VLM的通用能力进行整体评估。

blocks.en: Web Agents : Tests GUI navigation, grounding, and interaction in a digital environment.
blocks.zh: Web Agents :测试GUI导航,定位,以及数字环境中的交互.

blocks.en: Robotics & Egocentric Videos : Evaluate embodied perception, spatial awareness, and understanding of the physical world from a first-person perspective.
blocks.zh: 机器人与爱高中心 视频 : 从第一人称角度评价对物理世界的固有认知、空间意识和理解。

blocks.en: Games : Focus on strategic decision-making, reward modeling, and long-term planning in rule-based environments.
blocks.zh: 游戏:注重战略决策,奖励建模,规则环境下的长期规划.

blocks.en: Spatial Planning : Assesses foundational spatial awareness and reasoning, a critical component for any embodied agent.
blocks.zh: 空间规划:评估基本空间意识和推理,这是任何内含物的关键组成部分。

blocks.en: A crucial practical consideration is the feasibility of converting each dataset into a standardized, offline format. This criterion requires that the source data (e.g., trajectories, videos) be sufficiently structured to allow for an unambiguous conversion into a Multiple-Choice Question (MCQ) format. Every resulting MCQ must have a single, verifiably correct answer to enable scalable, deterministic, and efficient evaluation without relying on resource-intensive online simulators.
blocks.zh: 一个重要的实际考虑是将每个数据集转换成标准化的离线格式的可行性。 这一标准要求源数据(如轨迹,视频)的结构必须足够,以便可以毫不含糊地转换成多选择问题(MCQ)格式. 所产生的每个MCQ都必须有一个单一的,可核查的正确答案,以便能够在不依赖资源密集的在线模拟器的情况下,进行可扩展的,决定性的,高效的评价.

blocks.en: To ensure transparency, reproducibility, and accessibility for the broader research community, all selected datasets must be publicly available. Furthermore, their licenses must permit modification and redistribution as part of a new benchmark, allowing us to legally and ethically create and share AgentVQA.
blocks.zh: 为了确保透明度、可复制性和更广泛的研究界的可获取性,所有选定的数据集都必须公开提供。 此外,他们的许可证必须允许修改和重新分配,作为新基准的一部分,使我们能够在法律和道德上创造和分享AgentVQA。

blocks.en: The selected datasets need to be large enough to provide a diverse pool from which high-quality samples can be curated. A larger source pool increases the likelihood of finding samples that are both challenging and unambiguous across a range of question types. This criterion ensures that our manual curation process (Section 3.1 ) has adequate coverage of each domain and dataset.
blocks.zh: 选定的数据集需要足够大,以提供一个多样化的集合,从中可以整理出高质量的样本. 更大的源集合增加了在一系列问题类型中找到既具有挑战性又毫不含糊的样本的可能性。 这一标准确保了我们的人工校准程序(第3.1节)充分涵盖每个领域和数据集。

blocks.en: Appendix C Hard Negative Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 附录C 硬负生成管道

blocks.en: The difficulty of AgentVQA is ensured by a systematic process for generating challenging distractor options, or “hard negatives.” This process transforms tasks that are not inherently multiple-choice, such as web navigation trajectories, into a standardized and rigorous MCQ format. Our pipeline creates negatives that are both plausible and unambiguously incorrect, forcing models to demonstrate fine-grained understanding rather than relying on simple heuristics. The process is detailed below.
blocks.zh: AgentVQA的困难是通过产生具有挑战性的分心者选项或“硬负数”的系统过程得到保证的。 这个过程将并非内在多选择的任务,如网络导航轨迹,转变为标准化和严格的MCQ格式. 我们的管道制造出既可信又毫不含糊的负面现象,迫使模型表现出精细的理解,而不是依赖简单的休眠论。 这一进程详述如下。

blocks.en: To select the generation model, we first conducted a preliminary study on a data subset using Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-4o, and Qwen 2.5 VL (7B). After manually comparing the generated samples for both difficulty and accuracy, we selected Gemini 2.5 Pro for its superior performance. We therefore employ a VLM-assisted pipeline centered around Gemini 2.5 Pro to generate hard negatives. For each question, we provide the model with comprehensive context, including the primary image or screenshot, the task prompt, the ground-truth answer, any relevant action history for sequential tasks, and metadata such as image dimensions and coordinate formats (e.g., (x,y) for points, or ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2} ) for bounding boxes). For grounding tasks, we also visually render the correct action’s location onto the image. Given this context, we prompt the model to generate three distinct hard negatives as a combination of two types: near-miss negatives and semantically similar negatives . Near-miss negatives are distractors spatially close to the correct answer that test precision, such as coordinates a few pixels away from a correct UI element. Semantically similar negatives are conceptually related to the correct answer and test the model’s ability to differentiate between similar objects, such as choosing a “Mobile” phone when the correct answer is a “Tablet.” The exact prompt used for generating these “hard negatives” is in Appendix L
blocks.zh: 为了选择生成模型,我们首先对使用双子座2.5 Pro,GPT-4o和Quen 2.5 VL(7B)的数据子集进行了初步研究. 在手动比较生成的样本既困难又准确后,我们选择了双子座2.5 Pro的优异性能. 因此,我们使用以双子座2.5 Pro为中心、由VLM辅助的管道来产生硬底片。 对于每个问题,我们向模型提供全面的上下文,包括主图像或截图、任务提示、地面真实答案、任何相继任务的相关行动历史,以及元数据,例如图像维度和坐标格式(例如,(x,y)用于点,或(x, y, 1, x 2, y, 2xxxxxxxx1}, y_{1},x_{2},y_{2})用于边框的元数据。 在定位任务时,我们也将正确的动作位置刻在图像上。 在这种情况下,我们促使模型产生三种截然不同的硬负数,作为两种类型的组合:接近缺失的负数和非常相似的负数。 近误负是空间上接近测试精度的正确答案的分散器,例如坐标几像素远离正确的UI元素. 语义上相似的负数在概念上与正确答案有关,并测试模型区分类似对象的能力,例如当正确答案是“表”时选择“移动”电话。 产生这些“硬底片”所用的准确提示载于附录L。

blocks.en: To ensure quality, the generated negatives undergo a two-stage verification process. First, an automated script filters grounding-based distractors by verifying their coordinates fall outside the ground-truth bounding box, programmatically confirming the option is a “negative.” Following this, a subset of these samples undergoes a rigorous manual review. We manually verify each distractor for both plausibility, ensuring the option is a believable choice that could confuse a model, and unambiguous incorrectness, which guarantees there is only one correct answer to the MCQ. This human-in-the-loop step is critical for ensuring the quality of the generated negatives prior to the manual curation stage described in Section 3.1 . The hard negatives produced by this pipeline form the initial candidate pool. The final 1000-sample benchmark undergoes additional manual curation (Section 3.1 ) to verify correctness, difficulty, and the absence of any ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 为确保质量,生成的负数要经过两个阶段的核查过程。 首先,一个自动脚本过滤器通过核查其坐标在地面-真实界限框之外,从而对地面-分散干扰器进行定位,在程序上确认这个选项是“负面的”。 之后,这些样本中的一部分经过严格的人工审查。 我们手动核实每个分散注意力者是否具有合理性,确保这个选项是一个令人信服的选择,可以混淆一个模型,以及毫不含糊的不正确之处,这保证了对MCQ只有一个正确的答案. 这一人工操作步骤对于确保生成的阴性物质在第3.1节所述人工加工阶段之前的质量至关重要。 这种管道产生的硬底物构成初始候选集合. 最后的1000个抽样基准需经过额外的人工审查(第3.1节),以核实正确性、难度和不存在任何含糊之处。

blocks.en: Appendix D Definition of Agentic Tasks
blocks.zh: 附录D 代理任务的定义

blocks.en: The community defines agentic tasks as those requiring a system to "observe their environment and act in it in order to achieve goals" Bengio et al. (2025) , encompassing perception to sense the state, intelligence to reason and plan, and affordances to execute actions Plaat et al. (2025) . While traditional image VQA treats visual understanding as an end in itself, agentic VQA frames perception as a means to action. Here, each answer must inform executable decisions rather than merely describe what is seen Reed et al. (2022) . To ensure AgentVQA captures this full capability range, we structure our sub-tasks into a unified hierarchy: Action Grounding tasks (e.g., Tap) test the critical translation of semantic intent into executable spatial actions Reed et al. (2022) ; Spatiotemporal Reasoning tasks evaluate the dynamic mental maps required for movement; State Understanding tasks (e.g., Functional Reasoning) ensure the agent can accurately parse the environment to inform decision-making; and Strategic Planning tasks (e.g., Reward Modeling) assessing long-term outcomes through multi-step reasoning Sutton et al. (1998) .
blocks.zh: 本社区将代理性任务定义为需要系统"观察环境并在其中采取行动以实现目标"(2025年),包含感知状态,智慧理性和计划,以及支付执行行动的费用. Plaat等人(2025年). 虽然传统图像VQA将视觉理解本身视为目的,但代理VQA帧感知则作为行动的手段. 在此,每项答复都必须为可执行决定提供参考,而不只是描述Reed等人(2022年)所看到的情况。 为了确保AgentVQA捕捉到这个全能力范围,我们把我们的子任务构建成一个统一的等级: 动作定位任务(如Tap)测试语义意图的关键翻译为可执行的空间动作Reed等人(2022年); Spatiotemperal 理性任务评价运动所需的动态精神图; 国家理解任务(如功能理性)确保代理人能够准确剖析环境为决策提供信息; 战略规划任务(如奖励建模)通过多步骤推理Sutton等人(1998年)评估长期结果.

blocks.en: Appendix E Answer Extraction Logic
blocks.zh: 附录E 解答提取逻辑

blocks.en: To ensure consistent and automated evaluation, we employ a multi-strategy answer extraction logic. Although the prompt instructs models to output only a single letter corresponding to their final choice, outputs can vary. Our programmatic parser is designed to robustly handle these variations.
blocks.zh: 为了确保一致和自动化的评价,我们采用了多战略的解答提取逻辑。 虽然即时指示模型只输出一个与其最终选择相对应的单个字母,但输出会有所不同. 我们的方案分析器旨在有力地处理这些变化。

blocks.en: The extraction process follows a prioritized sequence of rules. First, our parser attempts a direct match, checking if the model’s entire stripped output is exactly a single, valid option letter (e.g., ‘A’). If this primary strategy fails, it deploys a fallback routine that applies a series of regular expression patterns. These patterns are designed to find common answer declarations such as “Answer: A,” or “Option A.” We note that these regular expressions are occasionally adapted to accommodate the unique, consistent output formats of specific models. If no unambiguous answer can be identified after applying all strategies, the question is skipped and marked unevaluated to maintain the integrity of the evaluation. The complete prompt is available in Appendix K .
blocks.zh: 提取过程遵循优先规则顺序. 首先,我们的解析器试图直接匹配,检查模型的全部剥离输出是否完全是一个单一有效的选项字母(如‘A'). 如果这个主策略失败,它会部署一个应用一系列正则表达式模式的倒置常规. 这些模式旨在找到诸如“答复:A”或“备选A”之类的共同答案声明。 我们注意到,这些正则表达式偶尔被调整,以适应特定模型的独特、一致的产出格式。 如果在应用所有战略后无法找到明确答案,则为了保持评价的完整性而忽略并标出未评价的问题。 完整的提示载于附录K。

blocks.en: Appendix F Robustness Analysis of MCQ Format
blocks.zh: 附录F MCQ格式的强度分析

blocks.en: To ensure the reliability of the multiple-choice format, we conducted extensive ablation studies to quantify the impact of option ordering and rule out random guessing as a confounding factor.
blocks.zh: 为了确保多选择格式的可靠性,我们进行了广泛的消化研究,以量化选择顺序的影响,并排除将随机猜测作为混淆因素.

blocks.en: We evaluated 5 representative models across 6 datasets using 5 distinct, seeded random permutations of option orders. As shown in Table 3 , the model performance remains highly consistent across permutations, with a standard deviation of approximately 1.9 % 1.9\% . This confirms that the rankings reported in AgentVQA are stable artifacts of model capability rather than positional bias.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了6个数据集的5个代表性模型,使用了5个不同、种子随机的选项订单。 如表3所示,模型性能在各种形态上仍然高度一致,标准偏差约为1.9% 1.9% 。 这证实了AgentVQA中报告的排名是模型能力的稳定文物,而不是位置偏差.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Robustness to Option Ordering: Average accuracy across 5 random permutations of option orders. The low standard deviation indicates high stability.
blocks.zh: 表3: 选择的自强性 顺序 : 选择命令的5个随机排列的平均准确性。 低标准偏差表明高度稳定性.

blocks.en: To verify that model scores reflect genuine engagement with the task, we evaluated constant-selection baselines (e.g., “Select All A”, “Select All B”) across the benchmark. These strategies yielded accuracies of 28% (A), 27% (B), 23% (C), and 22% (D), averaging 25.0% , which aligns with the theoretical random baseline for 4-option MCQs. Since all 22 models in Table 1 achieve overall accuracies above the 25% random-guessing baseline (lowest: 28%), we conclude that AgentVQA measures performance beyond chance at the full-benchmark level.
blocks.zh: 为了核实模型分数反映了对任务的真正参与,我们评价了整个基准的连续选择基线(如“选择全部A”和“选择全部B”)。 这些战略的速率为28%(A)、27%(B)、23%(C)和22%(D),平均为25.0%,这与4个选择的MCQ的理论随机基线一致。 由于表1中所有22个模型都实现了超过25%随机猜测基线(最低:28%)的总体加速,我们得出结论,AgentVQA在全基准水平上衡量超出机会的性能.

blocks.en: Appendix G Error Modes
blocks.zh: 附录 G 错误模式

blocks.en: To qualitatively understand model failures, we conduct an in-depth error mode analysis on Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google, 2026 ) . The process involves a three-stage methodology to develop a taxonomy, annotate failures, and verify the results. The resulting distribution of errors is visualized in Figure 8 .
blocks.zh: 为了从质量上理解模型故障,我们对双子座3.1 Pro(Google,2026)进行了深度错误模式分析. 这一过程涉及一个分三个阶段的方法,以制定分类法、说明失败和核实结果。 由此得出的差错分布可视化于图8。

blocks.en: First, we prompt the model to output a reasoning chain alongside its final answer for every question. We then manually review a diverse, stratified subset of incorrect predictions to identify and define a comprehensive taxonomy of common failure patterns for each of the five agentic domains. With this taxonomy established, we use Gemini 3.1 Pro for large-scale annotation. For each failure, we provide the model with the visual input, all multiple-choice options, the ground-truth answer, the model’s incorrect chosen option, the model’s full reasoning chain, and any other relevant metadata. We then prompt it to assign the single most fitting error mode from our predefined taxonomy. The prompt used for assigning error modes is available in Appendix M .
blocks.zh: 首先,我们促使模型在每一问题的最后答案的同时,输出一个推理链。 然后,我们手动审查一组不同的、分层的不正确的预测,以确定和界定五个代理领域中每个领域的常见故障模式的全面分类。 随着这个分类学的建立,我们使用双子座3.1 Pro来做大规模的注释. 对于每次失败,我们向模型提供视觉输入,所有多选择选项,地面真实答案,模型不正确的选择选项,模型的全部推理链,以及任何其他相关的元数据. 然后我们促使它从我们预先定义的分类中 指定一个最合适的错误模式。 用于指定错误模式的提示符载于附录M。

blocks.en: To ensure the quality of the automated annotations, we perform a final verification step. We manually review a randomly selected subset with 100 error mode assignments across all domains. This process confirms that the classifications are accurate and consistent with our established definitions, ensuring the reliability of our qualitative analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了确保自动说明的质量,我们采取了最后的核查步骤。 我们手动审查一个随机选择的子集,其中包含所有域的100个错误模式任务. 这一过程证实,分类准确无误,符合我们既定的定义,确保了我们质量分析的可靠性。

blocks.en: G.1 Error Mode Definitions
blocks.zh: G.1 错误模式定义

blocks.en: Grounding Error occurs when the model understands the goal but fails to correctly locate or ground the corresponding UI element, often confusing it with a visually similar or nearby one. Logical Breakdown describes a failure to correctly process a sequence of steps, leading to a logically inconsistent action based on the current state. Visual Hallucination is when the model’s reasoning relies on a UI element or piece of information that is not present in the visual input. Missing Inference occurs when the model fails to deduce an implicit but necessary action, such as scrolling to reveal an element. Action Mismatch happens when the model’s reasoning correctly identifies the right action, but its final output selects a different, incorrect option. Goal Misunderstanding is a fundamental error where the model misinterprets or ignores a key part of the user’s instruction.
blocks.zh: 当模型理解了目标但未能正确定位或定位到相应的UI元素时,会发生搁浅错误,常常会将其与视觉上相似或附近的元素混淆. 逻辑分解(logical Bexcled)描述的是无法正确处理一系列步骤,导致基于当前状态的逻辑不一致的行动. 视觉幻觉是指模型的推理依赖于视觉输入中没有的UI元素或片段信息. 缺失的推论发生在模型未能推断出一个隐含但必要的动作时,例如滚动以揭示一个元素. 当模型的推理正确识别出正确的动作时会发生动作错配,但其最终输出会选择一个不同的,不正确的选项. 目标误解是一个根本错误,即模型误解或忽略了用户指示的关键部分。

blocks.en: Motion Misperception occurs when the model fails to correctly interpret a process, motion, or physical interaction as it unfolds over time. Perception Gaps are fundamental failures in seeing, where the model incorrectly reports a basic, static fact like an object’s presence or count. Spatial Confusion is a failure to build an accurate 3D mental map from video, resulting in an incorrect understanding of object layout or orientation from a given viewpoint. Incomplete Analysis happens when the model perceives all necessary visual facts but fails to execute the required logical steps to reach the correct conclusion. Task Misinterpretation arises when visual perception is correct, but the model misunderstands the nuance or goal of the prompt.
blocks.zh: 运动误解发生于模型无法正确解释一个过程,运动,或物理相互作用随时间推移而展开. 感觉 差距是根本的失明,即模型错误地报告一个基本、静止的事实,如物体的存在或数量。 空间迷惑(Space Confusion)是指无法从视频中构建准确的3D心理映射,导致从特定角度对物体布局或方向的错误理解. 不完全分析发生在模型察觉到所有必要的视觉事实但未能执行所需的逻辑步骤以得出正确的结论时. 当视觉感知正确时,任务错误解释就会发生,但模型误解了提示的细微或目标.

blocks.en: Spatial Confusion occurs when the model fails to correctly interpret the spatial relationships, location, or orientation of objects in 3D space from a 2D image. Object Misrecognition happens when the model misidentifies an object or fails to ground it based on all of its required attributes like color or size. Action-Time Disconnect is a failure to understand the dynamics of a scene, such as predicting the outcome of an action or correctly sequencing a task. Selection Error occurs when the model’s reasoning arrives at the correct conclusion, but it selects the wrong option in its final output. COT Failure describes cases where the chain-of-thought reasoning process breaks down, failing to handle specific quantitative values or fine-grained distinctions.
blocks.zh: 当模型无法从二维图像正确解释3D空间中物体的空间关系,位置,或方向时,空间混淆就会发生. 对象误认发生于模型误认一个对象或未能根据它的所有所需的属性如颜色或大小而将其打地. Action-Time Disconnection是无法理解一个场景的动态,比如预测一个动作的结果或者正确排序一个任务. 选择错误在模型的推理得出正确结论时发生,但它在最终输出中选择了错误的选项. COT 数字 失败描述的是思维链推理过程破裂,未能处理具体的量化值或细微的区分.

blocks.en: Visual Miscomprehension is a foundational failure to correctly perceive the game’s visual and spatial information, such as object locations or relationships. Rule Misunderstanding is a logical error where the model does not correctly apply the game’s explicit rules or objectives. Tracking Drift is a failure to mentally simulate and track how the game state changes over time. Reasoning Breakdown is a general failure where the model’s internal logic collapses under the task’s complexity or becomes confused about the objective, leading to a flawed conclusion. Context Hallucination occurs when the model’s reasoning becomes detached from the game state, inventing information that does not exist.
blocks.zh: 视觉错解(Visual Mistallerion)是正确感知游戏视觉和空间信息,如物体位置或关系的基础性失败. 规则错误(Rule Mistory)是一种逻辑错误,模型不能正确应用游戏的明确规则或目标. 跟踪漂流(Training Drift)是一种在精神上模拟和跟踪游戏状态随时间变化的失败. 理性崩溃是一种普遍的失败,即模型的内部逻辑在任务的复杂性下崩溃或对目标产生混淆,导致错误的结论. 当模型的推理与游戏状态脱节,发明不存在的信息时,便会出现上下文的幻觉.

blocks.en: Viewpoint Gap occurs when the model identifies objects but fails to construct an accurate 3D map of their relationships, leading to errors in judging depth or distance. Categorization Confusion occurs when perception is visually correct, but the model applies the wrong semantic label or category to an object. Detection Hallucination is a fundamental perceptual failure where the model either misses a present object or “sees” an object that is not there. Logic Collapse is a failure cascade where the model first fails to perceive an object and then tries to compensate by inventing a logical path forward based on hallucinated information. Scope Misinterpretation happens when the model misunderstands the required granularity or intent of the question, particularly for counting or classification tasks.
blocks.zh: 视图点 当模型识别对象但未能构建精确的三维关系映射时会出现缺口,导致判断深度或距离出错. 分类混淆发生在视觉正确时,但模型将错误的语义标签或类别应用于一个对象. 检测幻觉是一种基本的感知失败,即模型要么错过了现物体,要么“寻找”一个不存在的物体。 逻辑折叠(Logic Collapse)是一种故障级联,在这种级联中,模型首先无法感知到一个对象,然后试图通过根据幻觉信息发明一条逻辑路径向前进行补偿. 如果模型误解了问题所需的颗粒性或意图,特别是计算或分类任务,就会出现解释错误。

blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations of Open-Ended Grounding Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录H 不限成员名额地面测量的限制

blocks.en: In this section, we visualize why standard open-ended evaluation metrics (Bounding Box IoU and Distance Thresholds) introduce significant noise into agentic evaluation, and how AgentVQA’s MCQ format resolves this ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 在这个节中,我们想象一下标准开放式评价指标(Bounding Box IoU和远程阈值)为何在代理评价中引入显著噪音,以及AgentVQA的MCQ格式如何解决这一模糊性.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 4 , open-ended metrics often force a trade-off: loose thresholds or large bounding boxes allow false positives on irregular shapes (like the scissors), while strict thresholds punish valid actions on large elements (like the mouse). AgentVQA circumvents this by transforming the continuous coordinate space into a discrete decision problem, where distractors are programmatically ensured to be incorrect (e.g., outside the ground truth bounds) yet plausible enough to test precision.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,无限制的度量衡往往强制取舍:松散的阈值或大的边框允许在不规则形状上出现假阳性(如剪刀),而严格的阈值则惩罚对大元素(如鼠标)的有效行为. AgentVQA绕过这一点,将连续坐标空间转变为一个独立的决策问题,在其中,分心器在程序上得到保证是不正确的(例如,在地面真理界限之外),但具有足够说服力,可以测试精确度.

blocks.en: Appendix I Implications and Suggestions for Practitioners
blocks.zh: 对从业人员的影响和建议

blocks.en: AgentVQA provides unique diagnostic data unavailable in general VQA benchmarks. Based on the granular failure modes identified in our experiments, we offer the following concrete recommendations for future agentic model design and training:
blocks.zh: AgentVQA提供一般VQA基准中无法提供的独特诊断数据. 根据我们实验中查明的颗粒性故障模式,我们对未来的物剂模型设计和培训提出了下列具体建议:

blocks.en: • Accelerate Model Iteration: AgentVQA provides a scalable testbed for cross-domain performance. Evaluating complex agentic questions with a reasoning model judge (generating around 2,000 tokens per decision) requires millions of output tokens for a single pass. AgentVQA mitigates these massive computational costs by enabling rapid, deterministic scoring for faster development cycles. • Improve Visual Grounding: Among the analyzed incorrect Web Agents predictions from Gemini 3.1 Pro, 78% were classified as grounding errors: the model understood the goal but failed to locate the appropriate UI element. This identifies UI localization as a prominent failure mode in the analyzed sample and suggests it as a target for improvement. • Adopt Adaptive Inference: Since reasoning models often underperform on perception tasks, we recommend adaptive architectures that decouple fast, robust perception modules (for spatial awareness) from expensive Chain-of-Thought (for planning) to prevent “Thinking Loops.” • Implement Domain-Specific Curricula: The lack of correlation between general VQA and agentic performance suggests generic tuning is inadequate. Our granular error profiles suggest a move toward domain-specific curriculum learning, targeting 3D spatial data for Robotics versus causal reasoning for Games . • Deploy Offline Safety Gates: We propose using AgentVQA as a standardized diagnostic filter to detect critical reliability risks such as hallucinations and recursive loops before deploying agents into high-stakes, open-ended environments.
blocks.zh: • 加速模型迭代:AgentVQA提供跨域性能的可缩放测试台. 用推理模型法官来评价复杂的代理问题(每个判决产生约2,000个令牌)需要数百万个输出令牌才能单次通过. AgentVQA通过为更快的开发周期提供快速,决定性的评分来缓解这些巨大的计算成本. • 改善视觉地面: 在从双子座3.1 Pro分析出的不正确的Web Agents预测中,78%被归类为落地错误:模型理解目标,但未能找到合适的UI元素. 这把UI本地化确定为分析样本中突出的故障模式,并推荐作为改进的目标. • 采用适应性 推论 : 由于推理模型往往在感知任务上表现不佳,我们建议采用适应性结构,将快速、强健的感知模块(用于空间意识)与昂贵的思维链(用于规划)脱钩,以防止“思索循环 ” 。 • 实施特定领域 课程 : 一般的VQA和代理性能之间缺乏关联性,说明通用调谐是不够的. 我们的颗粒误差剖面显示, 正在朝着特定域课程学习方向发展, • 部署离线安全门: 我们建议使用AgentVQA作为标准化的诊断过滤器,在将Agents部署到高吸附,无限制的环境中之前,检测诸如幻觉和递归循环等关键可靠性风险.
